title: 第23章 什么东西，也敢伤她？
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
这些飞刃比方才的飞刀要更加锋利，路仙瑶立即紧急调转飞舟。

    本以为就此躲过这些飞刃，谁知，这些飞刃跟追踪导弹似的，拐了个弯继续袭来！

    靠！

    飞舟被击中，路仙瑶从飞舟坠落下来，她急忙一个翻身，稳稳落地。

    她抬头望去时，发现偷袭她的人，和方才被她困住的男子生着一模一样的脸，若不是衣服穿着不一样，险些便要以为是同一人了。

    是双胞胎！

    且此人的实力比方才的男子要更强一些，是筑基巅峰！

    “你若能交出紫河花，或能留你全尸！”念无疾冷声道。

    他和弟弟在白天的时候，隐藏在别处，看到了那一男一女采摘沼泽里的紫河花，惨死于妖兽之口，而此女却不费吹灰之力，便拿到了紫河花。

    要说算计，与他们不差分毫。

    可想要从她手中夺得紫河花，单看她身边四名筑基后期护卫，便不是易事。

    只能紧跟着她，再伺机而动。

    倒也不是他们不去跟那名黄衣女子，而是这名戴面纱的女子，身上所持的紫河花更多，才够他们分！

    原来他们兄弟二人在临渊沼泽的时候，就盯上她了。

    这苍山，螳螂捕蝉黄雀在后的可真多！

    “既然你们知道我乃瑶池西王母之女，还敢来抢东西，就不怕瑶池圣地追杀你们吗？”路仙瑶搬出瑶池圣地的威名。

    此人修为在自己之上，不可正面硬刚，先拖住他，再找机会逃之。

    且他们兄弟二人敢杀人夺宝，必定留有后手的，不可大意。

    “你死在这里，不就没人知道了？”念无疾眼中杀肃盛起，持剑朝路仙瑶刺去。

    “那就要看你有没有这个本事了。”路仙瑶握紧琅琊剑应对。

    可他速度极快，她甚至没有看清他的身形，就已经来到眼前，她只得以剑抵挡。

    “轰——！”

    他的剑气蛮横霸道，她被逼得连连后退好几米远，好在琅琊剑是柄灵剑，不然便要被他的剑气斩断了。

    好强！

    明明都是筑基，初期和后期差距也太大了些……

    念无疾跃身继续进攻，他的招式又猛又烈，路仙瑶根本找不到反击的机会，只能被动防守。

    她想要掏出法宝困住他一时半刻脱身，却被念无疾看穿，遏制住她取法宝的动作。
content_en:
These flying blades were sharper than the flying knives just now, so Lu Xianyao immediately turned the flying boat around urgently.

    I thought I could just dodge these flying blades, but who would have thought, these flying blades, like tracking missiles, turned a corner and continued to attack!

    Depend on!

    The flying boat was hit and Lu Xianyao fell from the flying boat. She quickly turned over and landed firmly on the ground.

    When she looked up, she found that the person who attacked her had the exact same face as the man she had trapped just now. If it weren't for the different clothes, she would have almost thought they were the same person.

    It's twins!

    And this person is stronger than the man just now, he is at the pinnacle of foundation building!

    "If you can hand over Zihehua, I might be able to keep your whole body!" Nian Wuji said coldly.

    During the day, he and his brother hid elsewhere and saw a man and a woman picking purple river flowers in the swamp and dying tragically from the mouths of monsters. However, the woman got the purple river flowers effortlessly.

    When it comes to calculations, it's no different from them.

    But if you want to get the Purple River Flower from her, it will not be easy just by looking at the four late-stage foundation-building guards around her.

    He could only follow her closely and wait for the opportunity.

    It's not that they don't go with the woman in yellow, but that the veiled woman holds more Purple River Flowers to give them enough to share!

    It turned out that the two brothers had been eyeing her when they were in Linyuan Swamp.

    In Cangshan, there are so many mantises stalking cicadas and oriole behind!

    "Since you know that I am the daughter of the Queen Mother of the West of Yaochi, and you still dare to come and steal things, aren't you afraid that Yaochi Holy Land will hunt you down?" Lu Xianyao pointed out the prestige of Yaochi Holy Land.

    This person's cultivation level is higher than your own, so you can't confront him head-on. Hold him back first, and then find an opportunity to escape.

    Moreover, if the two brothers dare to kill people and seize treasures, they must have backup plans, so they cannot be careless.

    "If you die here, no one will know about it?" Nian Wuji's eyes were full of murderous intent, and he stabbed Lu Xianyao with his sword.

    "Then it depends on whether you have the ability or not." Lu Xianyao responded by holding the Langya Sword tightly.

    But he was so fast that she didn't even see his figure clearly before he was already in front of her, so she had to use her sword to block him.

    "Boom——!"

    His sword energy was overbearing, and she was forced to retreat several meters away. Fortunately, the Langya sword was a spiritual sword, otherwise she would have been cut off by his sword energy.

    So strong!

    Obviously they are both foundation building, but the gap between the early stage and the later stage is too big...

    Nian Wuji jumped up and continued to attack. His moves were so fierce and powerful that Lu Xianyao couldn't find a chance to counterattack and could only defend passively.

    She wanted to take out the magic weapon and trap him for a moment to escape, but Nian Wuji saw through it and stopped her from taking the magic weapon.
title_en: Chapter 23 What dares to hurt her?
